overall_goal: Pour and spread batter into the frying pan

goals.description: Pour and spread the batter evenly in the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly pours batter from the bowl into the pan and spreads it evenly.

goals.description: Scrape the remaining batter from the bowl
goals.rationale: The person puts down the bowl and spoon, then picks the spoon back up to scrape batter off the bowl.

goals.description: Pour additional batter into the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person picks up the bowl again and pours more batter into the pan.
